blockPage.title: 403 Forbidden
blockPage.heading: 403 Forbidden
blockPage.message: Access to this server or resource is strictly forbidden.

admin.rowLabel: Block traffic from mainland China (temporary plugin)
admin.contextEnabled: Every visitor IP from mainland China now gets a 403 Forbidden page. Temporary plugin architecture — safe to remove completely in one command.
admin.contextDisabled: Temporary plugin: when enabled, visitors from mainland China see the standard 403 Forbidden page. Supports a whitelist and an admin-console exemption.
admin.blockCardDesc: Once enabled, visitors from mainland China get 403 Forbidden on every public page.
admin.exemptTitle: Allow administrators to reach the /admin paths
admin.exemptDesc: Recommended. If you manage the site from mainland China, this keeps the block from locking you out of your own console.
admin.testSubtitle: Live binary search against the authoritative APNIC ranges
admin.testPlaceholder: Enter an IP to test, e.g. 114.114.114.114 or 8.8.8.8
admin.testBlockedTitle: Would be blocked — IP {ip} belongs to mainland China ({type})
admin.testBlockedDesc: Requests to public pages return the 403 Forbidden block page.
admin.testPassedTitle: Allowed — IP {ip} is overseas or not a Chinese public IP
admin.testPassedDesc: Access to the site is unrestricted and passes normally.
admin.whitelistLabel: Whitelisted IPs or CIDR ranges (one per line, IPv4/IPv6)
admin.whitelistHint: Whitelisted IPs are exempt even when they are located in mainland China.

admin.uninstallOutro: The script strips the middleware hook, the admin settings row and the plugin folder — a 100% clean restore.
